text: `GenMarkdownTree(cmd, dir)` generates Markdown pages for a command and all descendants, using no file prefix and an identity link handler (`doc/md_docs.go:119-130`). `GenMarkdownTreeCustom` recursively processes available non-help-topic children, then creates `<CommandPath_with_underscores>.md` and writes the customized Markdown (`doc/md_docs.go:131-158`).
